CFB-week.summary: Both Oregon and Ohio State are on backup quarterbacks (Dylan Raiola for Oregon, freshman Luke Fahey for Ohio State) after injuries to Dante Moore and Julian Sayin. Miami visits Notre Dame without star WR Malachi Toney, who hurt his ankle in practice and was reported headed for surgery. Prop coverage on the line pages this week was thin for most quarterbacks, so the board leans on receiving and rushing yardage.

NBA-NY-at-CLE-1108.summary: Josh Hart (right ankle soreness) misses a second straight game; Landry Shamet started in his spot Wednesday. Cleveland is on the second night of a back-to-back and is without Jarrett Allen, Sam Merrill, Jaylon Tyson and Nae'Qwan Tomlin. Knicks are 4.5-point road favorites, total 224.5.

NBA-ORL-at-GS-1108.summary: Warriors (6-3, six straight wins) list Draymond Green (elbow), Gary Payton II (calf) and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis, practiced Friday) as questionable; Porzingis has stepped away from the team. Orlando is short-handed with Banchero, Suggs, Isaac, Penda and Nelson all out.

NFL-ARI-at-SEA-1108.summary: Both teams are on backup-level QBs: Seattle starts Drew Lock (elbow still recovering) for Sam Darnold (quad, week-to-week), and Arizona has benched and traded Jacoby Brissett, making Gardner Minshew the starter. Seattle is also missing LT Charles Cross, G Quenton Nelson and WR Rashid Shaheed; Arizona is without RB Bam Knight (concussion) and two starting linemen, leaving Tyler Allgeier as the lead back.

NFL-CIN-at-ATL-1108.summary: Neutral-site game in Madrid with an early 9:30 AM ET kickoff. Cincinnati's offense is healthy at the skill spots (Chase and Higgins both topped 140 yards in last week's overtime win) but TE Erick All is on IR with a reported torn ACL, leaving Gesicki and Sample. Atlanta is without RB Brian Robinson Jr. and WR Zachariah Branch (both hamstring), concentrating backfield work on Bijan Robinson with Khalil Herbert as the next back.

NFL-DAL-at-IND-1108.summary: Dallas has several pass-catchers in doubt: WR George Pickens (questionable after limited practices all week) and both TEs Jake Ferguson (ankle) and Luke Schoonmaker (groin), with KaVontae Turpin out. Javonte Williams is carrying a heavy load (24 carries last game). Indianapolis is missing CB Justin Walley and LB Akeem Davis-Gaither, and TE Tyler Warren is past his groin issue.

NFL-DEN-at-CAR-1108.summary: Denver's receivers practiced fully (Waddle and Bryant through a chest issue, Sutton upgraded Thursday) while safeties Brandon Jones is out and Hufanga questionable. Carolina's defense is without Okereke, Phillips and CB Will Lee III; Denver's TE snaps are split three ways and Jonah Coleman leads the backfield.

NFL-DET-at-MIA-1108.summary: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) is questionable after three limited practices and Detroit has ruled out C Cade Mays plus defenders Campbell, Reed, Joseph and Wonnum. Backup RBs Vaki (DNP Friday) and Saylors are questionable, while Miami's Willis practiced fully and Achane is on IR; consensus now Lions -7, total 50.5.

NFL-GB-at-NE-1108.summary: New England is without A.J. Brown (knee) and TreVeyon Henderson (illness); Hunter Henry (foot) is questionable after a limited Friday practice and Mack Hollins may come off IR. Rhamondre Stevenson is the lead back (76% of snaps last game). Green Bay is missing Micah Parsons plus interior linemen Sean Rhyan and Travis Glover.

NFL-HOU-at-LAC-1108.summary: The 0-7 Chargers have Herbert healthy and McConkey and Tre Harris back, but LG Awosika, TE Njoku and WR Thompson are doubtful and LT Slater remains on IR; Harbaugh says Hampton gets more touches. Houston is without RB David Montgomery (Woody Marks stays lead back) and S Reed Blankenship.

NFL-LA-at-WAS-1108.summary: Washington lost RB Jeremy McNichols and starting DTs Daron Payne and Javon Kinlaw to IR this week and has ruled out WRs Treylon Burks and Dyami Brown. Stafford is on the report with right elbow soreness but says he has practiced fully; he has not topped 33 attempts in three games. Rams CBs McDuffie and Curl missed practice and are questionable.

NFL-LV-at-SF-1108.summary: San Francisco is down three receivers (Evans, Kirk, Samuel ruled out), with Jordan Watkins and Brandin Cooks moving up and Demarcus Robinson likely activated from IR. McCaffrey was cleared after a mild hamstring strain (DNP Wednesday, limited Thursday, practiced Friday), and Nick Bosa returns for the defense. Raiders are missing DT Thomas Booker; CB Darien Porter practiced fully Friday.

NFL-NYG-at-PHI-1108.summary: Philadelphia benched Tanner McKee for Joe Milton III, who makes his first career start, and is again without WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks plus CBs Jonathan Jones and Michael Carter. Saquon Barkley was limited Thursday and Friday but carries no designation. For the Giants, Tyrone Tracy is on IR and Cam Skattebo is doubtful, leaving Devin Singletary as the lead back.

SOCCER-day.summary: Winks (Cagliari) is a back-injury doubt; Bayern, PSG and Palace carry heavy absences (Palace without Mateta and Sarr, PSG without Dembele and Kvaratskhelia), and Vinicius is suspended for Real Madrid. No current MLS news found.

fix.summary: Quick availability check on flagged Top-list picks. No listed player is ruled out. Wisconsin QB Colton Joseph is not expected to start vs Rutgers. Knicks without Josh Hart, Cleveland thin on a back-to-back, Hawks sat Jalen Johnson Friday.

NBA-POR-at-LAL-1107.summary: Portland is without Ja Morant (Grade 2 hamstring, about four weeks) and now Vit Krejci, who coach Micah Nori said fractured his leg in Wednesday's win at Phoenix, thinning the guard and wing rotation further. For the Lakers, Sandro Mamukelashvili is listed questionable with an illness; no current update on his status could be confirmed.

NBA-TOR-at-MIL-1107.summary: Scottie Barnes is questionable with left adductor/groin soreness after playing 32 minutes Wednesday against Denver; if he sits, Allen Graves, Jamison Battle and Collin Murray-Boyles pick up minutes. Toronto is already without Kawhi Leonard and Nate Bittle; Milwaukee's only listed absence is Kam Jones.

NFL-CLE-at-NO-1108.summary: Deshaun Watson entered the concussion protocol Tuesday and missed practice through Thursday, so Shedeur Sanders took first-team reps and is expected to make his first start of the season; the line moved from Browns +2.5 to +3. Cleveland pass catchers Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) and Denzel Boston (calf) have been limited, and Alvin Kamara (back) returned to practice Thursday after missing Wednesday.

NFL-NYJ-at-KC-1108.summary: Jets WR1 Garrett Wilson is in the concussion protocol and missed Wednesday and Thursday practice, so he looks likely to sit; Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper Jr. become the top receivers with the tight ends expected to see more work. Breece Hall returned to a full practice Thursday after missing games since Week 3 with a quad, and Aaron Glenn said both he and Braelon Allen will play. Kansas City's Kelce and Rice went from limited to full by Thursday.
